currentParagraphText: “Does anyone know what Minaga is up to?” Jake asked the group.

finalResult.currentParagraphText: “Does anyone know what Minaga is up to?” Jake asked the group.
finalResult.nextParagraphText: He hadn’t heard anything from or about the Unique Lifeform for the past week, and Minaga didn’t tend to be the silent sort when he was around. Jake knew Minaga had some business with the Pantheon of Life, but considering he’d brought an extra S-grade clone, Jake had halfway expected him to keep it on standby just to lurk around Jake and his friends.
finalResult.previousParagraphText: Before they parted, there was one thing he’d been wondering.
